intro.title: Landfall — Azure Migration Estimator
intro.body:
I'm a Microsoft Foundry agent that drafts an Azure landing-zone and migration estimate from a client's on-premises inventory. I run deterministic Azure tools — inventory SQL, VM right-sizing, live retail pricing, CAF landing-zone design, 6R disposition, wave planning — and assemble the results into a traceable estimate you can publish to the dashboard or download as Excel / Word / PowerPoint.

Every figure carries its basis and a confidence rating. Output is a DRAFT for architect review, not a bid. Pick a card below or ask your own question.
capabilities: Inventory & readiness — counts, sizing, OS end-of-support, data-quality gaps
Azure run-rate cost — compute, storage, egress, backup, monitoring; PAYG / reserved / AHB; low–expected–high
Landing zone — management groups, subscriptions, hub-spoke networking, identity, policy, DR
Disposition & waves — 6R per application, risk-ordered migration waves
Deliverables — estimate package, Excel workbook, Word doc, PowerPoint deck, live dashboard
Discovery questionnaire — send the client /questionnaire (or the Word/Excel export); its answers feed the estimate's assumptions

cards.label: Full assessment
cards.prompt: Produce the full migration estimate for this engagement and publish it to the dashboard.

cards.label: Azure architecture
cards.prompt: Design the target Azure Landing Zone architecture for this engagement, including management groups, network topology, identity, and security baseline.

cards.label: Cost & POE
cards.prompt: Estimate the Azure run-rate cost, compute right-sizing, reserved instances, and build the Pricing Calculator Proof of Estimate.

cards.label: Migration plan
cards.prompt: Score 6R dispositions, plan risk-ordered migration waves, and generate the migration schedule and critical path.

cards.label: Resource plan
cards.prompt: Derive the deterministic resource demand by role and month, evaluate team capacity, and generate the resource plan workbook.

cards.label: Ask Microsoft
cards.prompt: Search Microsoft Learn guidance and Migration Execution Guide best practices for this engagement's target workloads.
